text:
anya: Heads up — during ql8b-int4 bringup our sampled promptbank shows a 3.4x increase in near-duplicates after the synthetic expansion step. Not sure if this is sampling inflation or a bug in the augmenter.
liam: ugh. can you paste the quick numbers? dup rate before vs after?
dani: before ~6%, after ~21% (fuzzyhash J=0.85). ran a quick pass on the latest snapshot.
anya: thanks. looks like many are paraphrase-variants and short suffix repeats from the paraphraser, plus some exact noise.
marco: could be the paraphraser's temperature or beam size. what config did we use for synth_aug v2?
anya: synth_aug v2 — temp=0.9 beam=1, top_p=0.95. I suspect the beam=1 + high temp created many short rephrasings.
samir: agree. quick mitigation: freeze synth_aug for new sampling, snapshot current seedbank, and run a dedupe pipeline on the expanded bank.
liam: ops plan ack. what dedupe heuristics do we want? exact hashes, fuzzy J>=0.92, and also a prefix/kvcache-aware shorttext rule?
anya: proposal: (1) exact MD5 dedupe, (2) fuzzy Jaccard with shingle=3 threshold 0.92, (3) short-prefix rule for prompts < 40 chars -> stricter threshold 0.97.
dani: sounds good. I'll run a dry-run and report counts. command I'll use:

`python tools/dedupe_fuzzy.py --input s3://redwood/samples/ql8b/expanded-2026-03-21.jsonl --shingle 3 --threshold 0.92 --short-threshold 0.97 --out s3://redwood/samples/ql8b/expanded-dedupe-dryrun.jsonl`

marco: add `--keep-representative 1` to keep oldest anchor per cluster.
anya: also snapshot the golden set before any mutation: `golden-v3-2026-03-21.tar.gz` so we can roll back.
liam: labeling impact: after dedupe we expect ~2k fewer items in the active labeling queue. need to coord with Labeling to avoid losing in-progress work.
samir: pinging @labeling-bot to throttle new assignments for ql8b for 2 hours while we run cleanup :hourglass_flowing_sand:
labeling-bot: acknowledged. throttling assignments for `ql8b-*` to 0/min for next 120 minutes. :white_check_mark:
anya: after dedupe/dryrun I'll push a patch to samplebank config to disable synth_aug v2 and route to synth_aug v1 for now.
dani: dry run results: dedupe estimate removes 18.3% of expanded set; of that, ~55% were paraphrase near-duplicates, ~30% exact, ~15% short-suffix noise. full run scheduled at 4132110000.
marco: plan for golden: we should not automatically delete any golden anchors. instead: create golden-candidates from dedup clusters where a non-golden is preferred by quality score > golden_score by 0.05 and flag for human review (up to 150 candidates).
anya: yep — I'll assemble the candidate CSV and tag for the golden-audit rotation tomorrow morning. @dani please include `reason` and `cluster_examples` columns.
dani: will do.
liam: QA checklist for post-run: sampling parity test (N=5k), eval harness run on ql8b-int4 vs ql8b-fp16 baseline, and a small human spotcheck (50 items) for hallucination/regression.
anya: scheduling: dedupe full run at 4132110000, samplebank switch at 4132113600, golden candidate audit at 4132140000. tagging oncall if anything fails.
samir: I'll add an alert for labeler-queue-shrink > 5% unexpected and model-eval-delta on the dashboard.
anya: thanks all. keeping this thread for status; will post the command outputs and counts after the run. :eyes:
